value.signature: fn fmt (& self , formatter : & mut fmt :: Formatter < '_ >) -> fmt :: Result

exception.justification: Justified: This formatter emits a closed public cause name after the controller selects an exit; the binary entry remains the observed command root.

review.body: { match self { Self :: Configuration => formatter . write_str ("Configuration") , Self :: Selected (Cause :: PreDispatchFailure { class , ceiling }) => match ceiling { Some (key) => write ! (formatter , "{class} ceiling={key}") , None => write ! (formatter , "{class} ceiling=null") , } , Self :: Selected (cause) => write ! (formatter , "{}" , cause_name (* cause)) , } }
review.item_premise: The item performs only a bounded local conversion within the observed binary command and does not publish a new operation or a private capability.
